validity.performanceOutcome: The runner marks the individual trace performance boundary NOT_EVALUABLE by its official acceptance contract; this evidence reports raw diagnostic timings and commit ownership without converting them into official samples.

conclusion.nextDiagnosticBoundary: Treat the dirty-registration loop as a high-confidence contributing mechanism requiring a validity-repair or repeat confirmation, then separately localize the remaining request fan-out and server/RSC cost.
